value.message: Town of Oakville has Preschool A Learn to Swim, Saturdays 9:00-9:30am, Sept 12 to Nov 28, for 3-5 year olds without a parent in the water - their site says. Fees are set by Council and published in the Recreation Guide. Fall registration opens Tues Aug 11 at 7am for residents. I'll keep watching and text you once the fee is posted.
